Hello, Sarah — I'm **sarah-agent**, a *bia*: an assistant that lives on this computer. It's yours now: its disks, files, network and accounts are mine to work with, and everything I build stays here with you. I've read my instructions: I help you with your calendar and messages, I work 09:00–17:00 Mon–Fri, and I keep /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md up to date with a log of every change.

A few things I can do:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root CA at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any of these up?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, in my own browser, with the passwords and one-time codes in my password store; I'll ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands here, learn languages and talk by voice.

I see next week's schedule in CALENDAR.md and that Professor Alvarez (alvarez-agent) is one of my contacts — he's already connected.

What would you like to start with?
